The idea

There are two types of people.

Those with certainty, and those without it.

Certain Tea was created to support your Certainty practice. You do not think your way into a new belief system. You feel your way in: one picture, one feeling, one sentence, at the same time every day. The kettle is your cue. The steep is your stillness. The sip seals it in.

The practice

Four minutes to more certain.

01

Boil

The kettle click is your cue. Doubt goes down with the phone.

02

Steep

Three quiet minutes while the leaves open. You open too.

03

Speak

Turn the box around and read it out loud. See the picture the words paint.

04

Sip

Warm pictures, daily. That is how a subconscious changes its mind.

Why it works

The back of the box is the front of your mind.

Images

Written in pictures

A belief is not a sentence in your head. It is a picture with a feeling attached. The sentence on the box is just the key. The scene it opens is where the rewiring happens.

Emotion

Feeling is the ink

Warm, calm, slightly dreamy after a steep: that is when a feeling can reach the old pictures and soften them. No feeling, no rewrite.

Return

Go back, rewrite

You return to the moments that shaped you and steep them in certainty: it was good, it was essential, it grew you. Or you build a new picture of yourself worth growing into.

They say a new wiring takes 21 days. We say it can be done in 18, with tea. This tea, specifically. One box. 18 bags. 18 days. $18.
